provenance.notes: Newly authored PLACEHOLDER opponent values; original pairing policy and battle payload are unknown. The request-match parser at file 35C32A reads MTCH-RETCD and stores opponent ID/name/level/seed/host/path/count fields in RAM before wrapper 35C6B0 can return 9. The match route here is a static dialogue-entry response with RETCD 0. It does not implement the RETCD 0/2/3/5/6 sequence. Separate prepared-call probes exercised individual wrappers, including 35C8F2 with RETCD 3; these are not a continuous handshake or natural entry. Parser 35C5D6 copies a response body only for RETCD 2 or 5. Its number primitives stop at space or LF; CRLF can corrupt Content-Length and prevent its LF blank-line search. An 80-byte CRLF response parsed as 1021 bytes in prepared probes, so no battle payload is served or claimed. No saved-account, visible battle or complete online feature is established by this definition.
